# vappcloud_operation (Data Source)

Reads a durable operation by opaque public ID and routes compute, application, and VMM operation IDs to their owning API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vappcloud_operation" "selected" {
  id = "operation_example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `correlation_id` (String) Correlation ID.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `error_code` (String) Terminal error code.
- `error_message` (String) Terminal error message.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `kind` (String) Operation kind.
- `request_id` (String) API request ID.
- `resource_id` (String) Mutated resource ID.
- `state` (String) Operation state.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
